entries.title: Tapered Pierced Wedge And Continuous Wire Loop Nut
entries.description: One newly authored complete fixed wired-nut-inspired decorative display lying at rest. One solid tapered wedge head contains two genuine full-length rectangular bores. One entire continuous closed pale cable loop runs through both bores, returns in a small exposed upper bend and opens into one broad lower loop. A whole short dark sleeve surrounds the two lower strands. The wedge has a broad finite flat sole and the lower cable has finite polygonal resting facets. Three complete closed components with three opaque constant untextured PBR roles, metre units and native Z up, whole horizontal bounds centred at the ground datum. All numeric head, hole, cable and sleeve geometry is new: no cam lobes, trigger mechanism, ascender shell, carabiner or prior equipment fragments imported. One independent model zero scenes. Category-level outdoor-equipment appearance only, no branding, numbers, markings or exact commercial product. Deliberately fixed cable seating overlaps the inner bore walls locally to root the visual assembly while leaving true open air strips; not real manufacturing clearance, sliding fit or cable construction. Smooth solid cable exterior rather than strands, no internal swage detail. Pure static visual prop only, never actual climbing equipment: no placement, protection, rope use, fall arrest, strength, load rating, certification, manufacture, user fit or safety capability made or verified. No rigging, animation or interaction.

entries.title: Crescent Body End Grips And Three Arched Handles Bag
entries.description: One newly authored complete static crescent-training-bag-inspired exterior in a flat resting pose. One continuous closed softly faceted crescent body swells across the rear arc and narrows into two integral long end grips, with blunt finite capped tips. Three complete short arched band handles rise separately from the outer shoulder, each with two rooted terminals and a real open interval. The main body has a continuous finite flattened underside. Four whole closed meshes, three constant opaque untextured PBR roles, metre units native Z up and full horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. Numeric profiles, variable crescent cross sections and all handle paths are newly authored; not a cut lifebuoy, two attached old bags, an extracted suspended heavy bag, or a travel holdall with its mouth filled. One independent model zero scenes. Generic unbranded exercise-equipment appearance only: no exact commercial design, stitching, logos, weight labels or prescribed size. Closed solid exterior without internal filling or fabric thickness simulation; dark tips are integral material regions, not removable handles. Static decorative game art only, no actual mass or weight, exercise routine, fitness effect, lifting or swinging, flexibility, grip fit, strength, load, manufacture, certification or safety capability made or verified. No rigging, animation or interaction.

entries.title: Whole Open Papery Calyx and Globose Berry Physalis
entries.description: One wholly newly authored Physalis-like fruit assembly: a whole uncut orange-yellow globose berry remains seated inside its complete papery calyx, whose five pointed lobes are deliberately opened and bent back to reveal it. The calyx is one continuous thin closed shell with an attached basal cup, five broad folded panels, true outer clefts and a short whole curved pedicel. Its muted straw surfaces carry only a few real fold ridges and solid colour bands, not image textures. All calyx profiles, shared shell topology, berry dimensions and stalk path are new, not an extracted strawberry fruit, recoloured pomegranate, earthstar ray-count change or reused leaf kit. One complete botanical fruit prop, zero scenes, approximately seven-centimetre opened display width and two-centimetre berry. The opened pose and finite basal underside are explicit display conventions: natural inflated closed husk, paper translucency, microscopic venation, hairs, internal seeds, growth and exact species identification are not reconstructed. This is not a whole living plant or a food-safety/edibility, medicinal, physical-stability, rig or animation claim.
